name: Thermal Rainbow Topography
description: Topographic terrain visualization with thermal imaging color grading. Contour lines with neon glow trace evolving mountainous terrain rendered in a bright rainbow thermal palette from black through blue, cyan, green, yellow, red to white. Mouse creates glowing hot spots on the landscape. Upgraded (Batch 36): domain-warped FBM geological strata, curl-noise advected thermal currents, Worley micro thermal cells, feedback-based thermal diffusion of the height field, guarded FFT-bin shimmer, and click-ripple heat rings.
